The claim considers only the superseded December 31, 1983 date and does not examine January 31, 1984, so the 1986-02-25 end is not supported against an apparent earlier own-terms end on 1984-01-31 (inclusive).

Ending by EO 12553 and the four-section inventory are correct, but section 3 is misdescribed. The judgment_reason says section 3 'restates the section 9A(c) status-quo period of 120 days from creation of the board' and then that 'when it ran out depends on the unrecorded report date.' The held text of section 3 runs the standstill 'from the date of the creation of the board, and for 120 days thereafter', with no reference to the report.
